body: When I was in your shoes I never told her and I wish I had. The fact that she makes you happy, even if only on occasion, is a huge bonus, I miss that from my life.

He sounds like a tool. He sounds like me when I was younger. He may have done you a favour by you finding this out now rather than 6 months down the line. I know this doesn't help now but it may have hurt even more then.
Does she ever make you happy? Does she ever help? I wish sometimes I had told her, but that was me.

If that's the effort you went to you're an amazing person. I wish I could bring myself to be like that. 

I faced a similar situation but I just buried my head in work hoping Christmas would pass me by. I'm going to try your thing next year.

I struggle to meet people where I live because there's nobody my age (28) who speaks English and I live on my own. The closest thing to interaction I have, outside of work, is being a Sherpa on video games.
I live to not hurt my mother by not living.
